Deckfield All-Time

Every game of Seasons 1-9, as recorded. Classes mean the same thing in every season: Regional is a team's own conference; League is S5-S9's leagues and S3-S4's MRL/UTL; Interconference existed in S1-S4; Cup is the WCS, Grand Swiss, PA, RDS and S3's conference cups; Postseason is playoffs and finals. Byes count in no record. Some S1-S3 hosts were rebuilt from each season's own schedule (see the archive); every game has one.

Honours

From the Hall of Fame, plus S3's seven conference cups (decided by their two-legged finals). Cup is the season's main cup: the WCS (S3-S6), the Grand Swiss (S7-S8), the PA Cup (S9). Regional Cup is S3's conference cups and S9's Ribbon/Dream/Star. League is the top tier (MRL, Master, First Division); 2nd tier its next (UTL, Ultra, Second Division). Top 16 counts World Championship placings from No. 3 down.

Season by season

Elo across nine seasons

One continuous chain: every team opened S1 at 1800 (Lanakila's at 1800 in S2, Dynamax's from their S3 preseason, Phoenix's from S4's), and each season opens where the last one closed. S1-S3's Elo was computed afterwards, week by week. S5 applied its Elo out of game order, so a team's S5 stretch can jump; its values are as recorded.

Scoring changed fundamentally in S7 (and again in S8 and S9), so scoring records are kept per era. Goals were not recorded for most of S9.
